Your mission rationale, rigorous analytical calculations, software integration, and critical evaluations were exemplary.","next_steps":["Apply this rigorous combination of hand calculations and software simulations to future complex orbital trade studies.","Maintain your practice of incorporating honest critical appraisals of technical limitations in future project conclusions.","Leverage your high standard of technical writing and professional report formatting in your upcoming engineering projects."],"criteria":{"C1":"You achieved the Accomplished level by clearly establishing ZYZZsat's mission rationale, constellation trade-off, operator, and customers with strong literature citations in Section 1.","C2":"You reached the Accomplished level through exceptional analytical rigor in Sections 2.2–2.5, seamlessly combining analytical derivations with STK simulations and comprehensive subsystem planning.","C3":"You met the Accomplished level in Section 3 by synthesizing your key metrics alongside a candid, detailed evaluation of technical limitations and necessary next steps.","C4":"You satisfied the Accomplished standard with a logical structure, professional tone, polished figures, a clear executive summary, and properly integrated IEEE references."}}
